<div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>Item 2.02 Results of Operations and Financial Condition</b></div>

<div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>

<div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">On January 23, 2026, Ames National Corporation&#160;(Nasdaq: ATLO; the &#8220;Company&#8221;) issued a News Release announcing financial results for the three months and year ended December 31, 2025. A copy of the News Release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1.</div>

<div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>

<div style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 9pt;">&#160;</div>

<div style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt;">The Company hereby furnishes the Investor Presentation attached hereto as Exhibit 99.2, which includes financial information as of and for the three months and year ended December 31, 2025, and which may be presented at upcoming investor meetings.</div>

<div style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt;">&#160;</div>

<div style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt;">The information furnished in&#160;this Form 8-K, including Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2, shall not be deemed "filed" for purposes of Section 18 of the Exchange Act, or incorporated by reference in any of the Company's filings under the Securities Act or the Exchange Act, except as may be expressly set forth by specific reference in such filing.</div>
